title: Anthropic Posts $17 Bn in Q3 Revenue, Swings to Operating Loss
script:
Anthropic just posted seventeen billion dollars in revenue for the third quarter of 2026.
The company swung to an operating loss of five hundred sixty-seven million dollars.
These figures emerge from the latest financial disclosure provided by the San Francisco firm.
The shift toward an operating loss reflects massive investments in model compute capacity.
Analytics India Magazine highlighted these results before the expected initial public offering.
Can enterprise demand cover these costs before the company goes public?
